what_happened: Layout 10, transparent mint Straw011, GlassCup025. Stage 0 at 215 (drawer pushed back below 0.95 at 254-268 while reaching for the straw, then pulled to 1.57 at 288). Straw grasped 333-345, lifted 0.56 m, navigation 351-~600. 680-910 the straw was held vertically a few cm right of the cup (wrist view shows the cup just beside the gripper), never touching it. At ~920 the arm moved right/down toward the counter edge and released at 930, 0.35 m from the cup; the straw fell to the floor (end z 0.007). A close on air at 1253; no recovery.
causal_chain: straw beside the cup 680-910 (~230 steps) without inserting it -> moved to the counter edge and released (930) -> straw fell to the floor -> timeout
official_criterion_notes: Official success = straw touches the cup AND straw centre < 0.5 m horizontally from the cup centre AND gripper far; there is no 'inside' or upright test, so a straw lying across the rim or leaning on the outside of the cup would count once the gripper leaves. Stage 0's single 'undone' event (254-268) is the drawer being pushed in slightly during the straw approach, not a real undo.
uncertain_about: The straw is nearly invisible (transparent mint); the lateral offset from the cup is estimated from a few pixels.
